name: Time series

subjectOf.text: From 2007 to 2014 an increasing number of Form ADV Part II filers deemed investor due diligence worth mentioning, and an increasing number of filers qualitatively increased their due diligence disclosures in the brochure filings.
subjectOf.abstract: In sum, Figure 2 demonstrates that from 2007 to 2014 an increasing number of ADV II filers deem IDD worth mentioning, and an increasing number of ADV II filers qualitatively increased their due diligence disclosures in Form ADV II brochure filings.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Investor Due Diligence – Evidence from 1995 to 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811718
scope_conditions: SEC Form ADV Part II brochure filings

subjectOf.text: Since 2010 an increasing number of SEC Form ADV Part II brochure filers included investor due diligence disclosures, but the number of filers including such disclosures remained relatively even between 2012 and 2014.
subjectOf.abstract: an increasing number of SEC Form ADV II brochure filers included IDD disclosures and the number of filers who include those disclosures has remained relatively even between 2012 and 2014.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Investor Due Diligence – Evidence from 1995 to 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811718
scope_conditions: SEC Form ADV Part II brochure filings

subjectOf.text: Because tokens move in and out of the top 100 daily, the study limits its time series dataset to all available data on the top 100 cryptocurrencies until April 2018, selecting coins by market capitalization before April 2018.
subjectOf.abstract: Accordingly, the author limited the time series dataset to all available data on the top 100 cryptocurrencies until April 2018. The author chose cryptocurrencies for inclusion in the dataset based on the market capitalization of the respective coins before April 2018.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

subjectOf.text: The tokens in the sample of the top 100 cryptocurrencies were launched between January 2009 and March 2018, with the greatest number of top 100 coins launched in a single month occurring in November 2017.
subjectOf.abstract: This stable growth of new coins occurred with the greatest number of the top 100 coins by month launched in November of 2017.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: launch date measured by ICO start date or first trade date

subjectOf.text: Tokens launched before 2015 were overwhelmingly developed on a hardfork governance mechanism or a combination of hardfork and one other governance type.
subjectOf.abstract: Tokens launched prior to 2015 were overwhelmingly developed on a hardfork or a combination of hardfork and one of the other governance types depicted.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: top 100 tokens, governance types coded as hard fork, soft fork with tokenholder voting, masternodes, or other
